sub_parameters.name: Content
sub_parameters.description:
The configuration content. You can pass in one of the following values:

- The configuration content text. For the format, see [Driver and device information configurations](~~120906~~).
- The Object Storage Service (OSS) address where the configuration file is stored.

sub_parameters.name: Format
sub_parameters.description: The format of the configuration file. Valid values: KV (key-value pair configuration), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file).

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the configuration. This parameter is used to distinguish configurations when multiple configurations exist.

parameters.name: DriverId
parameters.description:
The ID of the driver. On the **Driver Management** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
